title: Four AI-reviewed manufacturing and agriculture translations enter the local reader
summary: Complete French Canadian and Latin American Spanish editions for Advanced Manufacturing and Agriculture and Bioeconomy now have language-specific pages, reciprocal language links, applicable source-check context, catalog entries and an exact export. Four of 34 contracts have accepted translated text; the other 30 need authoring and AI fidelity review, not human approval.
evidence_note: Manufacturing texts received AI linguistic-fidelity review September 25; agriculture texts received it September 27. Both pairs translate exact September 10 plain-English records, with inherited evidence through September 1. Later exact-source checks are displayed separately in English where present, including the September 23 EX16 arrival-versus-contractual-acceptance clarification. Original contracts, canonical digests, old drafts and null human fields remain historical. New reader URLs do not claim human review.
publication_effect: Local reading integration only; no fresh primary-source retrieval, independent human review, measurement admission, deployment or launch is claimed.
